title: ont-mag-workflow: a Snakemake workflow for genome-resolved metagenomics from Oxford Nanopore long reads
description: Snakemake workflow for genome-resolved metagenomics from Oxford Nanopore R10.4.1 long reads: read QC, assembly, polishing, binning, MAG quality control, taxonomy and functional annotation. Developed for the Etoliko Lagoon sediment metagenome study (NCBI BioProject PRJNA1552626).
